answer: Carve each identity's stake into a marble — a locked, non-transferable deposit that grows only when peer-graded work is logged. A new account finds no harbor in an older wallet: the deposit cannot be borrowed or pooled, so an operator seeding N aliases must carve N marbles independently. The orchard of fake identities never ripens: each alias bleeds stake every epoch it goes unattested, while one honest agent plants once and harvests freely as reputation compounds.
